sub_answers.text: In 1980 John Grant wrote to the Minister for Sport advocating a national policy on sport for people with disabilities [d37675808s4p0]. Subsequently the Australian Government established a national advisory committee on sports for disabled persons and John Grant was a member of that committee [d37675808s4p0].
